description: A single 150-unit exact-input swap on pool A collects a 1-unit hook fee (1% of gross output, rounded down). Creator intent R1 credits floor(1/2) = 0 rebate, and the EVM agrees, but the draft base specification imposes a minimum_rebate of 1 and predicts 1 earned unit. This transaction falsifies the specification's rounding rule without any contract violation, isolating the spec defect for the hosted judge.
